title: Closure under concatenation
statement: If $f$ and $g$ are polynomial-time computable functions from binary words to binary words, then the function sending each binary word $x$ to the concatenation $f(x)g(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: If $f$ and $g$ are polynomial-time computable string functions, then so is the function sending a string $x$ to the concatenation of $f(x)$ and $g(x)$.
